name: android_wait_for_condition
description: Waits on the computer until a condition holds, so the agent does not poll: element_present/element_gone (UI tree), activity_resumed, logcat_match (regex), image_present (a template image appears, for games; see android_find_image), screen_changed (the picture changes, e.g. after a tap in a game).

condition.description: Target state condition to wait for.

target.description: Target substring/regex for activity_resumed or logcat_match.

text.description: Target text to match for element_present/gone.

minChange.description: screen_changed: fraction of the screen that must differ (default 0.01; the status bar is ignored).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
